observations: Photo 0 shows a hand holding a black DSLR camera body with a lens attached and the lens cap on.
The word 'Nikon' is legible on the camera body's front/top area in photo 0.
A model badge (e.g. 'D810') is not clearly legible in the image; the text is too small/blurred to confirm.
The attached lens has a cap on, so no focal length or aperture markings (e.g. '24-70mm') can be read.
A watermark reading 'STARSHOOT IMAGE' overlays the photo, suggesting it may be a stock or reused listing image rather than an original seller photo.
No back-of-camera view, LCD screen, battery compartment, memory card slot, strap lugs, or power-on state is shown.
Only one photo is provided; no shots of serial number, shutter count screen, or lens glass/mount.

read_from: photo 0 body badge (partial, 'Nikon' legible; model text not confirmed)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon' branding but the 'D810' model text is not clearly legible in the image provided.
Lens cap is on in photo 0; no focal length or model markings are visible on the lens.
Only one partial angle is shown; condition of sensor, LCD, body dents, or wear elsewhere cannot be assessed.

risks.risk: Camera body model may not actually be a D810 (could be a cheaper or different Nikon body).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model badge on the front of the body or the top LCD panel showing 'D810'.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/generic Nikon DSLR body, not specifically D810

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 24-70mm or could be a different, lower-value lens.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens barrel with cap off showing focal length and aperture markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/generic kit lens, not as a 24-70mm

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have functional issues (shutter, autofocus, sensor dust/scratches).
risks.proof: Video clip or photo of camera powered on, showing LCD screen active and a test shot.

risks.risk: Shutter count could be very high, reducing remaining usable life.
risks.proof: Photo of shutter count from camera menu or from software like Nikon's shutter count check.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high shutter count/near end-of-life

risks.risk: Listing photo appears watermarked as stock image, raising doubt the photo is of the actual item being sold.
risks.proof: A fresh, unwatermarked photo of the actual item with today's date/newspaper or timestamp visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced with added discount for unverifiable item authenticity, treated as high-risk listing

risks.risk: Accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap, box) may not be included despite common bundling expectations.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body and lens only, no accessories

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model badge/top LCD confirming 'D810'.
Photo of the lens with cap removed showing focal length and model markings.
Video of the camera powering on, displaying menu, and taking a test shot.
Photo of shutter count from the camera's info screen or via diagnostic software.
Photo of the back of the camera showing the LCD screen and body condition.
A fresh photo without watermark, ideally with a handwritten note/date to confirm current possession.
response.reason: The single photo does not clearly confirm the D810 model badge or the lens's focal length, both of which are essential to set even a worst-case price for a camera system, and the watermark raises doubt about whether this is an original photo of the actual item.
